ja: 「キキ・ミカエル・アーガル」
キキ: こんにちは、\PN。
……どうして?

key: Why did you let me die?
en: Why did you let me die?
ja: どうして、私を死なせたの?
あなたがもっと強かったら……
違う結末になっていたはずなのに。
あなたはソラリスを倒した……

key: But still, you let him kill me.
en: But still, you let him kill me.
ja: それでも、あなたは彼に私を殺させた。
どうして、私を殺したの?
死とは……
……冷たくて……
……苦しくて……
……孤独なもの……

key: You feel the wind across your face, the warmth of your own body...
en: You feel the wind across your face, the warmth of your own body...
ja: 顔をなでる風、自分の体のぬくもりを感じる……

key: You feel all the light of life and then,
en: You feel all the light of life and then,
ja: 生きる光をすべて感じ、そして、
突然、闇。
世界がすり抜けていく。
心も、記憶さえも。

key: You hear your heart stop beating.
en: You hear your heart stop beating.
ja: 心臓が止まる音が聞こえる。
血が凍りつくのを感じる。

key: You try to cry, but you don't have tears to do so.
en: You try to cry, but you don't have tears to do so.
ja: 泣こうとしても、涙は出ない。

key: You try to scream, but you no longer have a voice.
en: You try to scream, but you no longer have a voice.
ja: 叫ぼうとしても、もう声は出ない。

key: Why would you do that to me?
en: Why would you do that to me?
ja: どうして、私にそんなことをしたの?

key: Was I so cruel to you?
en: Was I so cruel to you?
ja: 私はそんなに、あなたに酷いことをした?
私のことが、嫌いだった?

key: Did you cheer my disease onward?
en: Did you cheer my disease onward?
ja: 私の病気が進むのを、喜んでたの?

key: Were you just waiting for me to rot to peck at my corpse?
en: Were you just waiting for me to rot to peck at my corpse?
ja: ただ、私が朽ちていくのを待って、死体をついばむつもりだったの?

key: You will suffer as I have suffered!
en: You will suffer as I have suffered!
ja: あなたも、私と同じ苦しみを味わうことになる!
キキ: ……残念。

key: It would have been such fun, too.
en: It would have been such fun, too.
ja: せっかく楽しかったのに。

key: But you would not be deceived.
en: But you would not be deceived.
ja: でも、あなたはだまされてくれなかった。
あなたについていくわ、トレーナー。

key: Misdreavus is giggling. It seems to want to go with you.
en: Misdreavus is giggling. It seems to want to go with you.
ja: ムウマがくすくす笑っている。ついていきたそうにしている。

key: Do you want to take the Misdreavus with you?
en: Do you want to take the Misdreavus with you?
ja: ムウマを連れていきますか?
はい
いいえ
